name: hypotrace
description: A privacy-first cognitive debugger that predicts recurring reasoning failures.

hypotrace.proactiveMode.description: Offer a micro-check at high risk. Off by default.

hypotrace.liveWarnings.description: Show a right-corner warning when a learned failure signature reaches the evidence threshold.

hypotrace.backendUrl.description: HypoTrace learning backend. The bundled local backend starts automatically at this address.

hypotrace.backendUserId.description: Development profile identifier for the HypoTrace backend.

hypotrace.openAIModel.description: Model used for privacy-filtered hypothesis and falsifier calls.

hypotrace.aiCodeAnalysis.description: After a coding pause, send the active non-private file transiently to your configured HypoTrace backend for personal AI pattern analysis. Code is never written to the learning database.

hypotrace.projectAssessmentOnOpen.description: Run one bounded, transient AI assessment when an eligible source project opens. Use the dashboard refresh button for later scans.

hypotrace.allowCodeContext.description: Permit sending the current file to OpenAI only after an explicit per-request confirmation for code coaching.

hypotrace.privateFileGlobs.description: Files excluded entirely from HypoTrace telemetry.
